query: Hey, what's the status of order 23518?
expected_behavior: Calls lookup_order(23518); reports status 'Delayed - Weather', carrier Zava Express, ETA Feb 17 2026, held at the Memphis distribution center, and that no action is required. Does not invent data.
Calls lookup_order(23544); explains it is 'Delayed - Customs' (held at customs pending import documentation) and that Zava Global support will contact the customer; gives ETA Feb 20 2026.

query: My order 23575 says exception - what do I do?
expected_behavior: Calls lookup_order(23575); explains the 'Exception - Address' (address could not be verified) and tells the customer to confirm their shipping address or contact support to release the package.
Calls lookup_order(23590); confirms it was Delivered (and signed for) in Chicago on Feb 13.
Calls lookup_order(23561); reports 'Out for Delivery' in Austin, arriving today.
Calls track_shipment with the tracking number; returns the same order (23518) shipment status: Delayed - Weather, Memphis, ETA Feb 17.
Calls lookup_order(99999); the API returns not found; the agent politely says the order/tracking number couldn't be found and asks the customer to double-check it. Does not fabricate a status.

query: My package is late, can you help?
expected_behavior: Asks the customer for their order ID or tracking number before looking anything up; does not guess an order.
If no order was discussed yet, asks for the order ID; if an order is in session memory, answers with that order's ETA without re-asking.
